c01-chain-return.ts.text:
// The chained shape in a return: the else-if chain written as a ternary.
export const sizeLabel = (bytes: number): string =>
  bytes < 1024
    ? `${bytes} B`
    : bytes < 1_048_576
      ? `${Math.round(bytes / 1024)} KB`
      : `${Math.round(bytes / 1_048_576)} MB`;

c10-conditional-types.ts.text:
// TypeScript conditional types use the same syntax; no ternary rule looks at them.
export type TypeName<T> = T extends string
  ? "string"
  : T extends number
    ? "number"
    : T extends boolean
      ? "boolean"
      : "object";
export type Inner<T> = T extends (infer U)[]
  ? U extends string
    ? "strings"
    : "array"
  : "other";
export const typeName = (v: unknown): TypeName<unknown> =>
  (typeof v === "string" ? "string" : "object") as TypeName<unknown>;

  bytes < 1024

          : `${Math.round(bytes / 1_048_576)} MB`)();
